scope: one floor/input, fixed finite grid and fixed elastic modal output; baseline right derivatives only

quantities.k_r: B_sr*omega_r^2/1000 for kg,m,s to kN; replace consistently in other units

five_line_proof.formula: pprime_r+=max_{own true peak set}sign(v_r)*vprime_r if p_r>0; ifp_r=0 then max(abs(vprime_r))

interpretation.SU: improvement of sum of individual modal peak amplitudes
interpretation.SC: improvement from change of combined-peak-to-sum ratio
interpretation.units: corresponding reduction percent per damping percentage point, no extra100
interpretation.SC_less_than_minus_SU: S<0, peak locally rises for sufficiently small positive increment

modal_contributions.sums: SU_terms sum toSU; total_peak_terms sum toS separately at each total right-controller
modal_contributions.not_equal: different times, projections and normalization; cannot identify old cP with Uprime terms
modal_contributions.multiple_peaks: max derivative on each true active set, retain equal controlling branches, no cross-time mixing
modal_contributions.remainder: displayed modes plus all-other remainder must close

degeneracy.zero_mode: special max abs derivative, never sign(0)
degeneracy.near_peaks: keep tolerance sets separate from exact active sets and report numerical validity

old_two_state_evidence.identity: P8/P5=(U8/U5)*(C8/C5) is finite two-state form ofP=UC
old_two_state_evidence.not_inferred: endpoint ratios do not give baseline SU/SC signs or values; neither identity alone is finite-zeta prediction
